notes.title: New Demo Update!
notes.notes:
Hi everyone! 
I just released a brand new demo as well as a new trailer. I would love for you to go try it out and see if you can beat it.


New Features
Complete graphical overhaul with newer, better graphics and detail,

New NPC to meet and with a quest to complete his mission for a small reward,

New tutorial area to ease players into the controls better,

Dedicated speedrun-mode that unlocks after beating the demo,

Save system to store player progression between play sessions,

More graphics options to tweak (resolutions, v-sync, target framerate etc.),

And a bunch more small quality-of-life features..



If you encounter any bugs/issues, feel free to join the Discord (link down below) and provide more details. Much appreciated 🙏



Other than that, I hope you enjoy!

notes.title: New Years Update 🎉
notes.notes:
Hi everyone.
Happy new years! 🎉 Hope you all managed to get into 2025 well.

A small update from me and what my plan is in the near future.

I'm currently designing the final level of the game, meaning once I'm done with that, the game can actually be played from start to finish 🙂 
Obviously everything is still super rough around the edges and there's temporary graphics everywhere, but it will be nice to finally start seeing the light at the end of the tunnel.

And because of that, I'll soon begin to look for some playtesters to try out the new levels and provide feedback on the design, difficulty and so on. 
I'll make another post about it when the time comes, so stay tuned. Or you can join the Discord to get the updates even faster!

Also, Thomas Brush (the big gamedev youtuber) decided to make a dedicated video about my game and the 2 other games competing in an indie game showdown. It's a trimmed down version of the live stream, but with some added bits (and maybe a face reveal? 🌚)
Check it out in the link below! 

And lastly, I just wanna say a huge thanks to everyone here for following along my journey. I know that progress is slow and videos are far between, so thank you for having patience. I'm still working on it, almost every day.

That's it for now. 
Cheers everyone 🐔🪠
